props.title: Mesh pilot: Fordham Hill
props.description: 50-family Wi-Fi HaLow mesh on OpenMANET 902-928 MHz. Voice agents that go through walls — no cell tower, no ISP dependency. Community-owned infrastructure at ~$1K/family/year vs traditional ISP pricing.

props.title: Pooled-dues ledger
props.description: Dual-token cooperative model: $CAT (governance), $WORK (reputation SBT), $CRED (community credits). Two-house voting — token house 50%+ and citizen house 60%+. Quadratic voting via GroToken. 3.25x revenue / 4.4x profit projection vs traditional.

props.title: Food co-op group buying
props.description: Bulk grocery purchasing via Food-USD stablecoin. Hydroponics + fermentation micro-factory in underutilized spaces. AI-driven demand forecasting from household meal-plan data. $CRED credits keep value circulating locally.

props.title: Creator guild
props.description: Resident-run media pods: AI video, music, and art production. On-chain revenue splits via smart contracts. Pre-order funded events and merch. DARKXSIDE'S SCHOOL OF POWERFULMOVES curriculum built in.

props.title: Pilot-1 (archived)
props.description: Initial mesh test, 5 families, 3 months. Lessons learned.

events.title: DAO proposal presented to board
events.body: Cataclysm Studios DAO Fordham Hill Proposal v0.1 — parent DAO with 3 guilds (Infra & Cloud, Creator, Wealth & Learning). 90-day rollout with milestone gates.

events.title: Token suite designed
events.body: $CAT (governance, ERC-20), $WORK (reputation SBT, non-transferable), $CRED (community credits, stable). Two-house voting architecture locked.

events.title: Mesh gateway came up
events.body: Fordham Hill pilot gateway online. 47 households on the lattice.

events.title: Voice agent RVC model loaded
events.body: Flute-Gateway finished loading the Kokoro + RVC stack. Latency p95 = 142ms.

events.title: Tokenism W1 closed
events.body: G1 export wrapper + G3 firefly compose merge. 156 dry-run transactions.

events.title: Community co-design session
events.body: 12 residents, 3 hours, mapped the pooled-dues ledger schema.

events.title: Pilot kickoff
events.body: PMOVES.AI / Fordham Hill co-op. First node live.

props.title: DARKXSIDE: why mesh, why now (placeholder audio — final clip pending)
props.speaker: DARKXSIDE
props.transcript: So the question I keep getting is why bother with mesh when 5G exists. The answer is simple: 5G is not a right, it's a subscription. When the cell tower goes down in St. Maarten, the block goes dark. When the mesh node goes down, the block fixes it.

props.quote: We started with five families and a question. Eight weeks later, 23 households are on the lattice and the block votes on its own infrastructure.
This could be your voice. If you live at Fordham Hill and want to share what the pilot means to your household, reach out to the PMOVES team. Your story replaces this placeholder.
